## Modeling and Statistical Analysis of Extremes in Stationary Stochastic Processes

**Ioan Scheffel**  
Institute of Stochastics and Applications, University of Stuttgart

This cumulative dissertation was submitted to the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics at the University of Stuttgart for the degree of Doctor of Natural Sciences (Dr. rer. nat.). It studies the modeling and statistical analysis of extreme events in stationary stochastic processes.
